انتجبنا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَجَبْنَا (intajabnā) /in.ta.d͡ʒab.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# اُنْتُجِبْنَا (untujibnā) /un.tu.d͡ʒib.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
